title: create_sender accepts key_generation=None; fragment-wire consume has vacuous None match
description: SchcSessionManager.create_sender (python/src/lichen/schc/session_manager.py) accepts key_generation=None. activate_and_start then records a session whose key_generation is None, and the fragment branch of consume_fragment_wire (line ~353) checks self._key_generation_lookup(record.remote_signer_identity) is key_generation, which is vacuously true when the peer is unknown (lookup returns None). A caller holding the manager can therefore mint fragment wires for a keyless stranger that pass consume-time validation. Discovered while fixing project-LICHEN-worker6-edbw (control-wire branch fixed there with a non-None + identity check; the fragment branch needs the same guard, or create_sender should reject None at the trust boundary). No legitimate flow passes None: link/schc_handler.py create_fragment_sender indexes _key_generations[remote] (real object) and restore_persistence_state rejects None.
